parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL ID, name, maximum phase, type, and canonical SMILES for compounds reported in document CHEMBL4028801. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and inner join compound_structures on molregno to require canonical SMILES. Filter by document ChEMBL ID. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID ascending.
